University degree requirements

Besides the major and UB Curriculum requirements, every bachelor's degree needs:

  • At least 120 credits, with at least 30 completed at UB
  • At least 45 credits at the upper division (300-level or above), including those in the major
  • At least 90 Liberal Arts and Sciences (LAS) credits for a B.A. degree

Source: Undergraduate Catalog, Academic Policies and Procedures: University Degree Requirements
